ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Соблазн» (soblazn, 'temptation') is 'temptation', and Bentham's «искушающими тебя соблазнами» (iskushayushchimi tebya soblaznami) keeps its repetition, 'the temptations that tempt you'. «Верста» (versta, a Russian measure of about a kilometer) is kept as 'versts'. The Dhammapada attribution keeps its printed period inside the parentheses.
Source observation: [7] «По Лao-Tce» is typed with Latin a, o, T, c, e for the Cyrillic letters of «Лао-Тсе» (Lao-Tse); translated as “After Laozi”
